sql: SELECT "fees"."orderslink" AS e, AVG("fees"."rebtotal") AS m1, AVG((CAST(("fees"."rebrate" - "fees"."feerate") AS REAL) / "fees"."feerate")) AS m2 FROM "fees" GROUP BY "fees"."orderslink" ORDER BY m2 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: fees.relative difference of maker rebate rate from fee rate
why: average of total rebate per orders (by orderslink)
(maker rebate rate - fee rate) / fee rate: the relative difference of two quantities in fraction
average of relative difference of maker rebate rate from fee rate per orders (by orderslink)

sql: SELECT "fees"."orderslink" AS e, "users"."acctscope" AS g, AVG((CAST(("fees"."rebrate" - "fees"."feerate") AS REAL) / "fees"."feerate")) AS m1, COUNT(*) AS m2 FROM "fees" JOIN "orders" ON "orders"."recordvault" = "fees"."orderslink" JOIN "users" ON "users"."userstamp" = "orders"."userlink" GROUP BY "fees"."orderslink", "users"."acctscope" ORDER BY m2 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: fees.relative difference of maker rebate rate from fee rate
why: (maker rebate rate - fee rate) / fee rate: the relative difference of two quantities in fraction
average of relative difference of maker rebate rate from fee rate per orders within users.acctscope
